statement: Projection congruence ships with the full FR-32..FR-43/UB-4..UB-6/NR-4 matrix, exact-revision and working-tree conformance, every FR-41-addressable-prefix repair proof, checkpoint Q-state preservation, and the live Wiring rollup naming the verb
